display_title: The Last Master of Jongnam Sect
description:
*“You must be the one to reign over the world!”*

With those parting words, Jin Sanwol’s fate was sealed. At just 23 years old, he becomes the head of the Jongnam Sect, once a proud and powerful clan, now reduced to only eight remaining disciples and barely clinging to survival. Once a sect that dreamed of dominating the martial world, it is now a shadow of its former glory. Yet Sanwol cannot afford to grieve or hesitate. To honor his master’s dying wish, to keep the sect alive, and to carve a new path — Jin Sanwol must step into the ruthless world of martial arts, where only the strongest survive. The battle for supremacy begins anew, and he must stake everything to reclaim his sect’s former greatness… and conquer the martial world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
